title: Golden Laurel Warrior
description: A stern male warrior with braided hair and a golden laurel wreath stands in three-quarter view. He wears ornate golden and silver armor with large feathered wing pauldrons, a red gem brooch, and a glowing golden halo behind his head.
prompt: A handsome stern male warrior with long braided brown hair, wearing an intricate golden laurel wreath and glowing golden halo. He is clad in highly detailed golden and silver fantasy armor with large feathered wing pauldrons, a red gem at the collar, and a decorative sash. Dramatic cinematic lighting with a strong golden god ray from above, dark blue mystical background with faint columns and laurel motifs, painted in a realistic fantasy style with rich textures.
